maddeler.e:
نسبغل (form IVq)
# نَسْبَغِلُّ (nasbaḡillu) /nas.ba.ɣil.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْبَغَلَّ (isbaḡalla)
# نَسْبَغِلَّ (nasbaḡilla) /nas.ba.ɣil.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْبَغَلَّ (isbaḡalla)
# نَسْبَغِلِّ (nasbaḡilli) /nas.ba.ɣil.li/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْبَغَلَّ (isbaḡalla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
